issues.description: Duplicate React imports in step-3/page.tsx causing a build failure. The file has duplicate useState/useEffect imports which breaks the entire build and causes hydration errors across all pages including step-8a.
issues.root_cause: The file contains two separate import lines from 'react': one with `useState, useEffect` and another with `useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState`. The SWC compiler throws 'name is defined multiple times' error, breaking the build.

issues.description: step-8a page is stuck in loading state - never renders the result screen with before/after slider and AI-redesigned room image.
issues.root_cause: The build failure from step-3/page.tsx duplicate imports causes Fast Refresh to fail (404 error on RSC payload), which may be preventing the render pipeline from completing. Additionally, the step-8a page itself may have logic that keeps it in loading state.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove duplicate React imports. The file has two import lines from react with overlapping named exports (useState, useEffect appear twice). Merging them into a single import fixes the SWC build error 'name is defined multiple times'.
